authorship: Authored native-context teacher episodes using existing reviewed TRAIN summaries; not on-policy success or independent human gold.
rationale: The owner R1/R7 trial demonstrated native child reads and files but poor summaries, repeated successful writes from character/word confusion and one queued receipt. Teach useful summaries together with the actual depth-one reporting/stopping contract while retaining direct/semantic correction rehearsal.

native_interface.source_use: Observed depth-one runtime header and common IPython tool schema only. Evaluation assignment/source/output excluded.
native_interface.task_prompt: Authored for each TRAIN chapter through the same current _markdown_jobs helper as live setup; incidental provider warnings are not replayed.
native_interface.inherited_instruction_change: The observed child inherited an unconditional document-owner identity. Replace that task instruction with the current shared depth/assignment-aware wording, rather than teaching a conflicting role.
scaffold_changes: Shared task instruction distinguishes depth-zero ownership from assigned chapter-child work.
Child assignment and recovery explain that write_text returns characters, not words or a failure.
Owner assignment explains why a sleep loop over retained handles cannot finish and prevents message handling.

teaching.count_repair_selection: Existing reviewed summaries whose valid bullet-word count is within the task allowance but whose character count exceeds it; meaningful unit confusion, not arbitrary duplicate rows.
teaching.clean_sequence: Read complete assigned source; write reviewed bullets once; import json and send the exact chapter/path receipt to parent; stop.
teaching.repair_sequence: After a correct saved summary, an authored unchanged repeated write with mistaken count reasoning is masked. Current repeated-success feedback follows; supervise actual bullet-word counting, one parent send, then stopping.
teaching.native_receipt_result: Only printed queued status is scripted; the replay send stub validates exact payload/parent, saved reviewed file and single-send cardinality.

verification.test_runner_note: Initial isolated invocation lacked pytest; pytest-only rerun lacked the async plugin. Supplying pytest and pytest-asyncio ran all 47 task checks successfully. No live-host tests or environment edits.
